body_html:
@jethanj here you go.

#StopTheSteal
#smallpoems

"Landslide of Lies"

residue
of an
individual
can
   not
pluck
gravity's
strings
  in spiritual
rituals
that have
audacity
to honor
  travesty

let myths
sit
   in regolith
Do not
  bestow
a halo
No Afterglow
to push
debris flow

Silence
the violent
  Drop
hydro-static pressure
through seclusion
of the delusion

No silos
    to measure
an emphatic
  and tragic
saturation
of autocratic
attacks
on our
  unsteady
democracy

No
name
of such
pain
should
live in infamy
  Nor shouted with glee
Every conspiracy
needs a deep
cavity
As a new
Larimide orogeny
raises
Hearts and Mountains
aside me
fountains of truths
rather than lobotomies
spiraling in
landslides of lies
